cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 reports a certification, audit or assurance level for the system.
cells.note: Stage 4: in May 2026 Kenya's Maisha system runs on AFIS, which detects duplicate registrations from fingerprints when ID applications are processed. An August 2026 High Court order halting the Maisha Card pending a petition does not stop the national ID system, which was issuing cards in November 2026; no certification, audit or assurance level is held, so stage 5 is not met.
